note: AI wrapper SDK sample for docs/MODEL-WRAPPERS.md: one ai-app-select.mjs run per wrapper, merged in this order.

lists.method: GitHub code search through gh api (queries below), pool deduplicated by lower-cased full_name, repositories in other frozen lists removed, metadata through GraphQL, candidates ranked by stars then checked in that order until 25 pass. Exposure to retiring models is never consulted.
lists.bucketing: root package.json search split by exclusive size: ranges (inclusive endpoints never shared); source-import search split by path:; results deduplicated by lower-cased full_name before ranking
filters: dedupe by lower-cased full_name before ranking (D-19)
not a fork and not archived
recency by frozen-commit committedDate >= 2025-10-21 (D-12); pushedAt recorded only
the root manifest, or one apps/* or packages/* manifest (first 40 in path order), declares @ai-sdk/openai in dependencies

that manifest is private, or has no main/exports/bin/files, or the tree has an app marker (next.config.*, vite.config.*, wrangler.toml, app/, pages/, src/app/, src/pages/), or it depends on express, fastify, hono or koa
a non-test source file imports the SDK and makes a model call (chat.completions, responses, messages, images, audio, embeddings)
the tree passes Refit's scan limits (10000 files, 2 MiB per file, 50 MiB total)
repository name or topics do not match sdk|wrapper|client|langchain|llamaindex|provider|plugin|adapter|framework|boilerplate-generator (case-insensitive)
repository is in no other frozen list under docs/benchmarks
one level of apps/* and packages/* manifests; deeper nesting not read (D-11)
lists.sortOrder: stars desc, full name asc, within the retrievable code-search pool
